title: Illumina COVIDSeq Test: Synthesize First Strand cDNA
author: Opentrons
materials: Explanation of complex parameters below: * `P20 Multichannel GEN2 Pipette Mount`: Choose the mount position of your P20 Multichannel pipette, either left or right. * `Reservoir Labware Type`: Choose the type of reservoir that will be used for holding the master mix. **Note: Only the Bio-Rad Hard-Shell 96 Well Plate 200 µL plate will resume after Plate 1 and prompt for a refill of the master mix.** * `Plate 1 Columns`: Choose which columns master mix should be added on plate
Drop tips into Opentrons Fixed Trash Bin

steps.title: Configure robot parameters
steps.instruction: Select the P20 Multichannel GEN2 pipette mount (left or right), choose the reservoir labware type (e.g., Bio‑Rad Hard‑Shell 96‑well plate 200 µL – note this plate will resume after Plate 1 and prompt for a master‑mix refill), specify the columns on Plate 1 and Plate 2 that will receive master mix (comma‑separated list), and set the temperature module to the desired °C before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Transfer master mix to Plate 1
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 20 µL on Slot 10, pick up a tip, aspirate 8.0 µL of master mix from Column 1 (A1) of the Master Mix Reservoir, dispense the 8.0 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 located in Slot 11, then discard the tip into the Fixed Trash Bin.

steps.title: Transfer master mix to Plate 2
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 20 µL on Slot 7, pick up a tip, aspirate 8.0 µL of master mix from Column 1 (A1) of the Master Mix Reservoir, dispense the 8.0 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 2 located in Slot 11, then discard the tip into the Fixed Trash Bin.
